scopeVerdict: HOLD for treating the full molecular DNA leaf as compulsory prior mastery for these NI non-molecular source tasks. prerequisiteOnly changes projection role, not competency demands; it cannot cure a curriculum mismatch.

options.candidateRationale: Drop mandatory upper-systematics9dff prerequisite for this identification leaf; existing0380 identification-aid predecessor carries the required method. Preserve orientation. This also avoids making a grade6 task wait for upper evolution concepts.

Optional removal of the family-pedigree440 prerequisite preserves existing evolutionary-evidence700 and orientation; it eliminates this DNA path. It alone does not certify age-appropriate completeness of the broader target for NI or repair every scope mismatch.

narrowestAdoptionPosition: NI5 base remains368atoms446records with all old363 bodies intact. No optional requires delta is folded into base/script. Three bounded optional deltas are separately reviewable; molecular mutation/evolution routes remain explicit source/community scoped HOLDs.
